title: Titan Pro 15K Cool Mint Prefilled Pod + Refills
description: Cool Mint delivers a crisp, refreshing Mint flavour with a clean, cooling finish. Each puff offers clear, balanced flavour that feels bright and brisk without overpowering sweetness. Each Titan Pro 15K Prefilled Pod pack includes a 2ml pod and 10ml refill container, designed to work seamlessly with the Titan Pro 15K device. The mesh-coil pod ensures even vapour production, while the continuous auto-feed system provides steady coil saturation for consistent taste and vapour. How To Set Up Titan Pro 15K Pods Step 1 Insert the prefilled pod into the Titan Pro 15K device until it clicks. Step 2 Fit the 10ml refill container securely into the base compartment. Step 3 Inhale on the mouthpiece to vape. Replace both when empty. ✅ You're all set!
